title: The brave fight is inward
summary: This meets the self that still wants victory over other people. The line redefines courage as subduing the vicious ego within.
lifeApplication: Before the next argument, feel the heat in the face and ask what inside is trying to win. Keep the battle at the level of ego before you turn another person into the enemy.

source.shortMeaning: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person.
source.lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens, fight the ego within before you fight anyone else.

evidence.coreClaim: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person.
evidence.turn: Measure courage by how deeply ego is subdued.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next argument, feel the heat in the face and ask what inside is trying to win. Keep the battle at the level of ego before you turn another person into the enemy.
